messages:
dana: follow-up from today's all-hands reorg segment  collecting quick clarifications on headcount and next steps
rajesh: quick summary: no company-wide hiring freeze. we are redirecting incremental headcount towards latency/reliability work (runtime, Dedicated infra, SRE) for next two quarters.
emily: will managers lose hiring autonomy for those redirected roles?
rajesh: leads keep day-to-day hiring for team-critical roles, but any new reqs that touch prioritized pillars need alignment with central planning. justification template will be shared.
dana: what happens to reqs already in pipeline that aren't in those pillars?
samir: recruiting will reach out today with status per req. most will be paused, but offers already accepted or in final round proceed.
dana: internal mobility timing?
people-bot: Mobility window: Apr 4Apr 8. Apply via portal: https://intranet.redwood.com/mobility :link:
emily: if someone moves teams, how do we handle leveling/comp disputes?
rajesh: leveling calibrations will run immediately for materially changed roles; standard cadence for others. people-ops will fast-track disputes flagged as "reorg-impact".
dana: thanks. where do we send escalation if a critical customer-support role is at risk?
ceo: escalate to people-ops@redwood with subject "critical-customer-risk". execs will review within 48 hours.
dana: i'll summarize and post the follow-up doc. thanks everyone :)
